Camila, I read the policy on remote work. Honestly, I do not understand why headquarters changed it.
It changed so that the three countries have the same rule. Today each entity decides alone, and that creates problems in compliance.
And when does it come into effect? My team asked me this morning.
The effective date is the first of March. Until then, nothing changes for your team.
The policy says three days in the office. Here we agreed two days last year. Do I have to change it?
Yes, from March. But we send a local adaptation to headquarters, in order to explain the agreement you already have.
Good. And what do I tell the team? They will ask me the same question I asked you.
I pass the guideline on to you this week, so that you have the same words in front of you. It has five questions and five short answers.
That helps. One more thing: the first of March is a Sunday.
Thank you for pointing that out. I bear that in mind and I check the date with compliance today.

Hello everyone, this is Claire, with the announcement about the remote work policy. First the date: the policy comes into effect on the first of March. Until then nothing changes, and we use February to prepare and to explain it. Second, the reason, because every manager will ask. We changed it so that the whole group has one rule. Today each entity decides alone, and when an employee moves from one company to another inside the group, we cannot explain the difference. Compliance asked us to close that. Third, what I need from you. Each region sends me the local adaptation by the tenth of February. Put in it anything that does not work in your country, with the reason. Not a long document, one page. Thank you.

Camila, hello, this is the operations manager in Buenos Aires. I read the new policy this morning, and I want to be honest with you. The three days in the office are not my problem. My problem is that last year we signed an agreement with the union for two days, and my team read the new policy before I did, because it was sent to everybody at the same time. So this morning I have fifteen people asking me a question I cannot answer. What I need from you is two things. First, please include our agreement in the local adaptation you send to headquarters. Second, tell me what I can say to my team this week, even if the answer is that we are still checking. Thank you. Call me when you can.
